meta.name: spree
meta.description: Open Source Platform for DTC, B2B Commerce, Marketplaces & Omnichannel. REST APIs, TypeScript SDKs, and production-ready Next.js storefront. Self-host it. Own your data. No vendor lock-in. Zero platform fees.

install.title: Getting Started
install.html:
Try it in a sandbox

The fastest way to see Spree is a free sandbox: a hosted store with the admin dashboard and APIs, ready in your browser. Nothing to install — sign in, click Create store, and explore.

Install locally

Copy and paste the following command to your terminal to set up Spree locally in 5 minutes:

npx create-spree-app@latest my-store

This sets up the Spree backend, the React Admin Dashboard, and optionally the Next.js storefront in a monorepo. The storefront is built with Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, and TypeScript. Admin dashboard uses Vite and TanStack.

You need Node.js 24+, Git and Docker running. The backend runs as a Docker image, and you can configure it entirely with environment variables. Learn more in the installation docs.

Agentic Development

Spree comes with agent skills, which teach Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot and 60+ other tools Spree's conventions, customization patterns and upgrade flows. It also connects Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code to the documentation MCP server, so your agent can search the latest docs. This is automatically set up for you when you run npx create-spree-app and can be added to existing projects with spree add ai. See the Agentic Development docs for more details.

features.title: Features
features.html:
Everything below ships in this repository under the BSD 3-Clause license.

  • REST API & TypeScript SDKs — REST APIs for storefronts, admins and sellers, with publishable keys, scoped secret keys, rate limiting and OpenAPI 3.0 specs. Each has its own TypeScript SDK.
  • React Admin Dashboard — a Vite + React application built on TanStack Router and Query, shadcn/ui and Tailwind. Own it and customize without forking: change navigation, add/remove routes, modify table columns and insert your own UI widgets. Ships with a matching Seller Panel for marketplace vendors.
  • Next.js Storefront — open-source storefront built with Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, and TypeScript. Full shopping experience, multi-region URL routing, Stripe payments (Apple Pay, Google Pay, Klarna, Affirm), customer accounts, and SEO built in. Try the demo
  • Spree CLI — manage projects from the terminal (boot, generate, migrate, upgrade) and call the Admin API directly with spree api get/post/... — zero-config in local dev, built for scripts and AI agents.
  • MCP Server — built into the backend. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client to manage your store in natural language, limited to the permissions you approve.
  • Marketplace & Payouts — seller onboarding with a configurable requirements checklist, per-seller order splitting, a commission engine with EU commission taxation, and a payout ledger with Stripe Connect payouts.
  • B2B & Wholesale — price lists with volume tiers and negotiated rates, customer groups for segmentation, companies with locations, contacts and validated tax exemptions, and catalogs for per-segment assortments.
  • Payments — provider-agnostic payment sessions that finish reliably even when a tab closes. Ships with Stripe, Adyen and PayPal. Add your own with the Payment Provider SDK.
  • Promotions & Gift Cards — a rules-based promotions engine for percentage and fixed discounts, free shipping, BOGO offers and coupon codes, plus native store credits and gift cards.
  • Fulfillment — shipping, digital delivery and in-store pickup, delivery profiles and zones, multi-location inventory, and returns, exchanges and claims.
  • Taxes & Compliance — inclusive or added-on tax, automatic calculation via Avalara and Stripe Tax, cross-border customs fees & duties, and data privacy tooling for GDPR subject requests and EU Omnibus price history.
  • Products & Catalog — custom fields on any record, CSV imports and exports, digital products, product tags, a shared media library and bulk operations.
  • Provider Contracts — plug your existing stack in rather than replacing it: ERP, PIM, WMS and carriers, DAM, SSO and payouts.
  • Security & Identity — OpenID Connect single sign-on for staff and customers, custom auth adapters for any JWT issuer, role-based permissions scoped per store, and a PCI-compliant payment architecture where card data never touches your server.
  • MeiliSearch Integration — typo-tolerant product search and faceted filtering, or bring your own search provider.
  • Integrations & Extensibility — Event Bus, Webhooks, OpenTelemetry instrumentation, and native integrations (GA4, GTM, Klaviyo).
  • Agentic Development — agent skills teaching AI coding agents Spree's conventions and a docs MCP server, both set up with one command (spree add ai), plus LLM-ready documentation (llms.txt, per-page Markdown, offline npm package), and a generated AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md in every scaffolded project.
